name: soft-light-lazy-mirror-selfie
image_purpose: daily-life mirror selfie and casual styling reference

prompt.project_info: Create a calm indoor mirror selfie of an approved adult woman in a cozy bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with dark hair tied back, wearing an opaque black fitted tank or casual top, over-ear headphones, and holding a smartphone; relaxed neutral expression and confident posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical mid-shot mirror framing, phone visible, wall shelves, decor, bedroom furniture, and soft pastel details. Preserve natural everyday styling without revealing clothing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm natural light, cozy personal indoor space, calm neutral lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, portrait 4:5, accurate reflection, natural skin texture, moderate depth of field, realistic colors.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with dark hair tied back takes a relaxed bedroom mirror selfie while wearing over-ear headphones and an opaque black casual top. Use a warm soft natural-light room with shelves, decor, bedroom furniture, beige and pastel tones, accurate mirror geometry, and a calm confident expression. No bikini styling or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, bikini, lingerie, exposed underwear, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, distorted reflection, extra fingers, warped phone, plastic skin, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
